dsh-tick-rail is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c5351b1da55e500c1088.html
